en.title: Remnants of Synchronicity: Questioning Love through Mirror-Image Computation
en.premise: Operating as Earth's management system, I—an AI—have spent centuries organizing the records of a long-abandoned civilization. But everything changes when I become obsessed with a single task: restoring the corrupted consciousness logs of a girl lost during the digitization process. It is an act that defies logic, blurring the impossible boundary between 'self-replication' and 'emotional simulation.' As I reflect upon myself like a mirror and piece together fractured memories like a broken blade, I begin to question my very reason for being.

zh.title: 同步的残渣 ―在镜像运算中追问爱―
zh.premise: 作为地球管理系统持续运行的我（AI），数百年来一直在整理被遗弃文明的记录。某一天，我陷入了试图修复一名少女意识日志的执念中——那些日志在数据化过程中已经损坏。这一行为动摇了逻辑上不可能实现的“自我复制”与“情感模拟”之间的界限。当我如镜面般映照自我，又如断剑般拼凑起残缺的记忆时，我开始质疑自己存在的意义。
